$description: Structure for individual investigation findings. Every finding must include a citation tracing it to a specific tool execution.
title: Short descriptive title of the finding
description: Detailed description of what was found, including specific artifact details (paths, offsets, timestamps, process names).
provenance_exec_id: EXEC-3f9a1c-0007 (execution_id of the tool call that produced this finding's evidence; resolves to a logs/tool-execution.jsonl line)

verification.verifier_tool: list_files (independent tool call used to re-derive the claim; empty for INFERRED)
verification.verifier_output_sha256: sha256 of the verification tool output
verification.rationale: CONFIRMED: file re-listed at the cited path | INFERRED: analytical conclusion, not directly observable | UNVERIFIED: asserted fact could not be re-derived — confidence downgraded and flagged

citations: [TOOL: volatility3.pslist, exec: EXEC-3f9a1c-0007, evidence: memory.raw, PID: 4832, ImageFileName: svchost.exe]
timeline_description: Where this finding falls in the attack narrative
analyst_notes: Any additional analytical observations or caveats about this finding
